veranderings.rede: A word discussed as a word is marked with quotation marks so the learner reads it as the term.
The idiomatic Afrikaans form is 'al vier die ...', as in 'al drie die kinders'.

veranderings.blok: Kwaito en klassieke musiek langs mekaar
veranderings.na: sintetiseerder gemaak, en klassieke musiek dikwels
veranderings.rede: The bare comma joining the two halves reads as a comma splice; 'en' links them, as in the Genre item.

veranderings.na: Gebruik die woorde uit hierdie les
veranderings.rede: 'Die les se woorde' is wooden; 'die woorde uit hierdie les' is the natural phrasing.
Afrikaans prefers the compound 'musiektradisie' over the English-shaped 'tradisie van musiek'.
After a noun of time such as 'oomblik' the relative 'waarop' is the correct linker, not the conjunction 'wanneer'.
